scenes.title: Morning
scenes.narration: Long, long ago, before people wrote numbers down, a shepherd had sheep, and he needed to know: did they all come home? So each morning, when a sheep went out through the gate, he dropped a pebble in his bag. One sheep, one pebble.

scenes.title: Evening
scenes.narration: Each evening, when a sheep came home, he took one pebble out. One sheep, one pebble. But wait! One pebble is still in the bag. A sheep is missing!
